Jwt.//: The issuer, audience, lifetime and signing key of every token in the system. Inventory validates with the same values. The key here is published for local development: a real deployment sets Jwt__SigningKey (32+ characters) and the service refuses to start on the development key in Production.

Identity.//: Development accounts (manager, clerk, viewer, and the console's own relay account). Off here; appsettings.Development.json turns them on.
